title: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
abstract: arXiv:2611.34686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. translated_title: 技术报告 MEG2text：超越对齐的无创脑-文本解码
translated_abstract: 无创脑-文本解码旨在无需手术的情况下从大脑活动中恢复语言。其核心挑战之一是将学习到的脑-语言表征转化为准确的词语预测。我们提出了MEG2text，这是一个解码系统，结合了修正后的训练与评估流程、脑-文本对齐、类别平衡的词语读出机制以及目标词语言模型融合。在LibriBrain100的词语排序任务上，MEG2text达到了64.12%的平均Top-10平衡准确率，在四个语料库上比已发表的MEG-XL提升了16.92个百分点，且在每个语料库上均有提升。受控对比实验表明，实现层面的修正和学习式读出机制都对这一提升有所贡献。候选词层面的分析揭示，某些词语虽然获得了有信息量的分数，却始终输给竞争候选词；而相同特征条件下的对比表明，学习分类规则可以在不改变表征的情况下提升解码效果。
tldr: MEG2text通过修正训练评估流程、脑-文本对齐、类别平衡读出与语言模型融合，在LibriBrain100词语排序任务上将平均Top-10平衡准确率提升至64.12%，比MEG-XL提高了16.92个百分点。
en_tdlr: MEG2text combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and language-model fusion to achieve 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy on LibriBrain100 word ranking, improving over MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points.
